doc_notes: This document consists of two news wire reports discussing UFO-related folklore and disappearances in Colorado and Arizona; encounter content is present.

encounters.summary: Travis Walton claimed to have been abducted by aliens in 1975 and held for five days before being dropped off near a telephone booth.
encounters.quote: hauled poor 01' Travis Walton away from the pine woods of the Mogollon Rim for five days.

encounters.summary: Devin Williams disappeared after erratic behavior and claiming 'they made me do it' following a potential UFO-related incident near the Mogollon Rim.
encounters.quote: He said, 'They made me do it.'
